scope: Local HTTP/1.x shared head/body framing and one-request response sequencing; no transport client, SDK promotion or publication
ownership: Move-only parser/writer/decoder; owned event heads and bounded pending metadata; payload pointers borrowed only within Push; exact input acceptance/output generation
profile_limits: H1 strict request/head/framing profile remains; this is HTTP/1.x, not HTTP/2
Fixed/no-body/EOF/chunked writer; Upgrade/Tunnel plans are rejected by body construction and require explicit handoff
Generated chunks use lowercase hex without extensions; chunk-size lines and all pending metadata obey body framing/line budgets
Each Push emits at most one framing or payload span; retain unconsumed input and fully send generated output before producing more
Writer IsComplete means generated output, not transport delivery; EOF-delimited output still requires transport closure
Fixed/no-body excess is rejected; fixed and announced-chunk shortage fails UnexpectedEof; errors emit no output in the failing call and require discarding the connection
Chunk trailers must be safe and declared in Trailer head fields; captured metadata survives source mutation/move/drop; only empty repeated Finish is accepted
Response events stop at each 100..199 except 101 and then one final/101 head; missing final EOF fails even after informational heads
101 is a framing handoff, not upgrade-negotiation approval; successful CONNECT context preserves opaque tunnel bytes
Response limits bound each head, informational count and cumulative head bytes; errors report aggregate offsets
No request queue, TCP/TLS adapters, URL/redirect/pool/deadline/cancellation policy or live HTTP/HTTPS client claim
No macOS-x64/mobile, fuzzer/sanitizer, exhaustive allocation-fault, public-compiler/SDK, independent CI or release claim
Package remains a local uncommitted Git repository; parent gitlink and assigned public origin remain pending
imported_consumer: Response informational/final association, partial fixed output and fixed decoding, owned declared chunk trailers and decoder roundtrip across translation units
